name: javaabu-translatable-dev
description: Development tooling for the Inertia React components of javaabu/translatable. Apps don't install this; they import the components as @javaabu/translatable through javaabu/manifest.

scripts.format: prettier --write resources/js tests/js eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check resources/js tests/js eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
